'''Zathras Yellan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Yellan originally trained as a [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] in the the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] defense force of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], but after received word that the force was to be drafted into the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Yellan deserted and eventually joined the Alliance. At some point after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Yellan and a team of Rebel agents were [[Mission to Tazan|dispatched]] by the Alliance to the planet [[Tazan]], to destroy an [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] that was located on the world. After arriving on Tazan, Yellan and the rest of the team rendezvoused with the Alliance sympathizer [[Willer Clines]] in [[Willer Clines' House|Clines' house]], in the [[Desander Section]] of [[Tazan City]]. However, their conversation with Clines was secretly monitored by a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and once the stormtroopers believed that Rebels had revealed all that they would about their mission, the stormtroopers entered Clines' lounge and attacked Yellan and the rest of the Rebels. The agents escaped and eventually infiltrated the Data Processing Facility, where they extracted some Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] communications protocols and then blew up the structure.<ref name="UCD" />
